component.name: Mnemosyne
component.summary: PDF, EPUB, HTML, Markdown, MOBI/AZW, CBZ and text reader

description.p: A native desktop reader for PDF, EPUB, HTML, Markdown, MOBI/AZW, CBZ comic and plain text files.

ul.li: Highlights, notes and freehand annotations, exportable as Markdown, Anki cards or an annotated PDF
PDF form filling and password-protected PDFs
Library with shelves and tags, reading stats
Reading position and notes synced through a cloud folder or Google Drive
